LspClient's own notification route capability is `feat-lsp-notifications`, which is not what this feature does. Planner 2026-08-23 (turn 2, attach lifecycle): call `cache.attach(workspaceId, lease.client)` EXACTLY ONCE for each LspClient — immediately after the pool spawns the workspace — and call the detach function received in the same place the pool called `cache.forget(workspaceId)` at evict. ABSOLUTELY do not attach per lease (per acquisition/release): a warm JDT LS process serves many leases, so attaching per lease makes the client's handler array longer after each tool call. Be aware of one limitation: the cache detach function is currently only disabled with the `live=false` flag, not the actual detach function from the client (the `LspNotificationSource` port returns `void` so the detach function of `LspClient.onNotification` is discarded); With a one-attach-one-client lifecycle, the remaining closure is released with the client at evict.
